    GROUP BY StoreKey

    SELECT manager_key,
           manager_name,

  count() AS `客户数（分母）`,

WITH yearly AS (
    SELECT f.StoreKey,
           sumIf(f.SalesAmount, d.CalendarYear = 2008) AS sales2008,
           sumIf(f.SalesAmount, d.CalendarYear = 2009) AS sales2009
    FROM retail.FactSales f
    JOIN retail.DimDate d ON f.DateKey = d.DateKey
    WHERE d.CalendarYear IN (2008, 2009)
    GROUP BY f.StoreKey
),
same_store AS (
    SELECT StoreKey, sales2008, sales2009,
           (sales2008 - sales2009) / sales2008 AS decline_rate
    FROM yearly
    WHERE sales2008 > 0 AND sales2009 > 0 AND sales2009 < sales2008
),
ranked_stores AS (
    SELECT StoreKey, sales2008, sales2009, decline_rate,
           row_number() OVER (ORDER BY decline_rate DESC, StoreKey) AS rnk
    FROM same_store
),
top3 AS (
    SELECT * FROM ranked_stores WHERE rnk <= 3
),
cat_sales AS (
    SELECT f.StoreKey,
           if(p.ProductKey = 0, '未知产品', pc.ProductCategoryName) AS category,
           sumIf(f.SalesAmount, d.CalendarYear = 2008) AS c2008,
           sumIf(f.SalesAmount, d.CalendarYear = 2009) AS c2009
    FROM retail.FactSales f
    JOIN retail.DimDate d ON f.DateKey = d.DateKey
    LEFT JOIN retail.DimProduct p ON f.ProductKey = p.ProductKey
    LEFT JOIN retail.DimProductSubcategory ps ON p.ProductSubcategoryKey = ps.ProductSubcategoryKey
    LEFT JOIN retail.DimProductCategory pc ON ps.ProductCategoryKey = pc.ProductCategoryKey
    WHERE d.CalendarYear IN (2008, 2009)
      AND f.StoreKey IN (SELECT StoreKey FROM top3)
    GROUP BY f.StoreKey, category
),
cat_ranked AS (
    SELECT StoreKey, category, c2008, c2009,
           c2008 - c2009 AS category_decrease,
           row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY StoreKey ORDER BY (c2008 - c2009) DESC, category) AS cr
    FROM cat_sales
)
SELECT t.rnk AS `名次`,
       s.StoreName AS `门店`,
       round(t.decline_rate * 100, 2) AS `门店降幅(%)`,
       c.category AS `拖累最大的产品品类`,
       round(c.category_decrease, 2) AS `品类销售减少额`,
       round(c.category_decrease / (t.sales2008 - t.sales2009) * 100, 2) AS `占门店总减少额(%)`
FROM top3 t
JOIN retail.DimStore s ON t.StoreKey = s.StoreKey
JOIN cat_ranked c ON t.StoreKey = c.StoreKey AND c.cr = 1
ORDER BY t.rnk
turns.assumption: 同店指 2008、2009 两年均有销售的门店；门店降幅按销售减少额 ÷ 2008 年销售额计算，拖累最多按品类销售减少额最大判断，降幅和减少额均用正数表示。

), changes AS (

    category,

    revenue_2009 - revenue_2008 AS revenue_change,
    (revenue_2009 - revenue_2008) / nullIf(revenue_2008, 0) * 100 AS revenue_change_pct,
    gross_profit_2008,
    gross_profit_2009,
    gross_profit_2009 - gross_profit_2008 AS gross_profit_change,
    (gross_profit_2009 - gross_profit_2008) / nullIf(gross_profit_2008, 0) * 100 AS gross_profit_change_pct
  FROM cat

  row_number() OVER (ORDER BY revenue_change DESC) AS `名次`,
  category AS `产品品类`,
  round(revenue_2008, 2) AS `2008营收`,

  round(revenue_change, 2) AS `营收变化额`,

WITH store_year AS (

  FROM retail.FactSales
  WHERE toYear(DateKey) IN (2008, 2009)

  HAVING sales_2008 > 0 AND sales_2009 > 0

  FROM store_pivot
  WHERE sales_2009 < sales_2008

  SELECT StoreKey, decline_amount, decline_rate,
         row_number() OVER (ORDER BY decline_rate DESC, decline_amount DESC, StoreKey) AS rn
  FROM declined
  ORDER BY decline_rate DESC, decline_amount DESC, StoreKey
  LIMIT 3
), category_year AS (
  SELECT s.StoreKey,
         toYear(s.DateKey) AS yr,
         coalesce(nullIf(pc.ProductCategoryName, ''), '未知产品') AS category_name,

  FROM retail.FactSales s
  LEFT JOIN retail.DimProduct p ON p.ProductKey = s.ProductKey
  LEFT JOIN retail.DimProductSubcategory ps ON ps.ProductSubcategoryKey = p.ProductSubcategoryKey
  LEFT JOIN retail.DimProductCategory pc ON pc.ProductCategoryKey = ps.ProductCategoryKey

  GROUP BY s.StoreKey, yr, category_name

  SELECT StoreKey,

  FROM category_year
  GROUP BY StoreKey, category_name

  SELECT StoreKey, category_name, decrease,

WITH

  FROM retail.FactOnlineSales AS f

  WHERE f.DateKey >= toDate('2009-01-01') AND f.DateKey <= toDate('2009-12-31')

),
pc AS (
  SELECT a.pk AS pa, b.pk AS pb, count() AS n
  FROM op AS a
  INNER JOIN op AS b ON a.onum = b.onum AND a.pk < b.pk
  GROUP BY pa, pb
  ORDER BY n DESC, pa, pb
  LIMIT 10
),
po AS (
  SELECT f.ProductKey AS pk, count(DISTINCT f.SalesOrderNumber) AS oc
  FROM retail.FactOnlineSales AS f
  WHERE f.DateKey >= toDate('2009-01-01') AND f.DateKey <= toDate('2009-12-31')

)
SELECT
  pa.ProductName AS product_a,
  pb.ProductName AS product_b,
  pc.n AS common_orders,
  round(pc.n * t.N / (po_a.oc * po_b.oc), 4) AS lift

INNER JOIN retail.DimProduct AS pb ON pc.pb = pb.ProductKey

  GROUP BY product_key_1, product_key_2
),

  FROM retail.FactOnlineSales
  WHERE DateKey >= toDate('2009-01-01') AND DateKey <= toDate('2009-12-31')

WITH order_products AS (

    SELECT

        groupUniqArray(ProductKey) AS ps

    GROUP BY SalesOrderNumber
    HAVING length(ps) >= 2

    -- 订单内两两组合（i < j），一个订单对每个产品对只计一次
    SELECT
        ps[i] AS product_a_key,
        ps[j] AS product_b_key,
        count() AS order_cnt
    FROM order_products
    ARRAY JOIN arrayEnumerate(ps) AS i
    ARRAY JOIN arrayEnumerate(ps) AS j

    row_number() OVER (ORDER BY pc.order_cnt DESC) AS `名次`,

       concat('ProductKey=', toString(pc.product_b_key)),

FROM pair_counts AS pc

WITH inv AS (

  FROM (
    SELECT ProductKey, DateKey, sum(OnHandQuantity * UnitCost) AS Amt
    FROM retail.FactInventory
    WHERE DateKey >= toDate('2009-01-01') AND DateKey <= toDate('2009-12-31')
    GROUP BY ProductKey, DateKey
  )
  GROUP BY ProductKey
),
cogs AS (
  SELECT ProductKey, sum(TotalCost) AS Cost
  FROM retail.FactSales
  WHERE DateKey >= toDate('2009-01-01') AND DateKey <= toDate('2009-12-31')
  GROUP BY ProductKey
),
k AS (
  SELECT ProductKey FROM cogs
  UNION DISTINCT
  SELECT ProductKey FROM inv
),
base AS (
  SELECT
    k.ProductKey AS pk,
    coalesce(c.Cost, 0) AS cost,
    i.AvgInvAmount AS avg_inv,
    if(coalesce(p.ProductName, '') = '', toString(k.ProductKey), p.ProductName) AS pname
  FROM k
  LEFT JOIN cogs c ON c.ProductKey = k.ProductKey
  LEFT JOIN inv i ON i.ProductKey = k.ProductKey
  LEFT JOIN retail.DimProduct p ON p.ProductKey = k.ProductKey
)
SELECT
  row_number() OVER (ORDER BY cost / nullIf(avg_inv, 0) DESC, pk) AS `名次`,
  pname AS `产品名称`,
  toString(pk) AS `产品编码`,
  round(cost, 2) AS `2009年销货成本`,
  round(avg_inv, 2) AS `2009年平均在手库存金额`,
  round(cost / nullIf(avg_inv, 0), 4) AS `库存周转率`
FROM base
ORDER BY `库存周转率` DESC, pk

WITH outages AS (
  SELECT StoreKey, toStartOfMonth(DateKey) AS month, sum(DownTime) AS downtime
  FROM retail.FactITSLA
  GROUP BY StoreKey, month
), sales AS (
  SELECT StoreKey, toStartOfMonth(DateKey) AS month, sum(SalesAmount) AS sales
  FROM retail.FactSales
  GROUP BY StoreKey, month
), pairs AS (
  SELECT s.StoreKey AS store_key, s.sales AS sales, ifNull(o.downtime, 0) AS downtime
  FROM sales s
  LEFT JOIN outages o ON s.StoreKey = o.StoreKey AND s.month = o.month
  SETTINGS join_use_nulls = 1
), store_lvl AS (
  SELECT store_key, sum(sales) AS st_sales, sum(downtime) AS st_downtime
  FROM pairs GROUP BY store_key
), dev AS (
  SELECT store_key, sales, downtime,
    sales - avg(sales) OVER (PARTITION BY store_key) AS sales_dev,
    sales / nullIf(avg(sales) OVER (PARTITION BY store_key), 0) AS sales_idx,
    downtime - avg(downtime) OVER (PARTITION BY store_key) AS downtime_dev
  FROM pairs
), pm AS (
  SELECT count() AS store_months,
    count(DISTINCT store_key) AS stores,
    countIf(downtime > 0) AS months_with_outage,
    round(corr(sales, downtime), 4) AS corr_store_month,
    round(avgIf(sales, downtime > 0), 2) AS avg_sales_with_outage,
    round(avgIf(sales, downtime = 0), 2) AS avg_sales_without_outage
  FROM pairs
), dv AS (
  SELECT round(corr(sales_dev, downtime_dev), 4) AS corr_within_store,
    round(avgIf(sales_idx, downtime > 0), 4) AS idx_with_outage,
    round(avgIf(sales_idx, downtime = 0), 4) AS idx_without_outage,
    round(avgIf(sales_idx, downtime > 0) - avgIf(sales_idx, downtime = 0), 4) AS idx_gap
  FROM dev
), st AS (
  SELECT round(corr(st_sales, st_downtime), 4) AS corr_store_level
  FROM store_lvl
)
SELECT
  stores AS `门店数`,
  store_months AS `门店月观测数`,
  months_with_outage AS `有故障的门店月数`,
  corr_store_month AS `相关系数_门店月层面`,
  corr_within_store AS `相关系数_门店内去均值`,
  corr_store_level AS `相关系数_按门店汇总`,
  avg_sales_with_outage AS `有故障月平均销售额`,
  avg_sales_without_outage AS `无故障月平均销售额`,
  idx_with_outage AS `有故障月销售额指数`,
  idx_without_outage AS `无故障月销售额指数`,
  idx_gap AS `指数差`
FROM pm CROSS JOIN dv CROSS JOIN st
turns.assumption: 把「销售表现」取为全渠道销售额（retail.FactSales，按门店 × 月汇总），把「有故障」定义为该门店当月存在 IT 故障记录（无记录按停机 0 分钟计），并用门店内去均值的相关系数排除门店规模差异。

WITH daily AS (
  SELECT s.StoreKey AS StoreKey, s.DateKey AS dt, s.sales AS sales, coalesce(d.downtime, 0) AS downtime
  FROM (SELECT StoreKey, DateKey, sum(SalesAmount) AS sales FROM retail.FactSales
        WHERE StoreKey IN (SELECT StoreKey FROM retail.DimStore WHERE StoreType = 'Store') GROUP BY StoreKey, DateKey) s
  INNER JOIN (SELECT StoreKey, DateKey, sum(DownTime) AS downtime FROM retail.FactITSLA GROUP BY StoreKey, DateKey) d
    ON s.StoreKey = d.StoreKey AND s.DateKey = d.DateKey
)
SELECT count() AS store_days,
  countIf(downtime > 0) AS outage_days,
  countIf(downtime = 0) AS normal_days,
  uniqExact(StoreKey) AS stores_with_sla,
  round(avgIf(sales, downtime > 0), 2) AS avg_sales_outage,
  round(avgIf(sales, downtime = 0), 2) AS avg_sales_normal,
  round(avgIf(sales, downtime > 0) - avgIf(sales, downtime = 0), 2) AS diff_abs,
  round((avgIf(sales, downtime > 0) - avgIf(sales, downtime = 0)) / nullIf(avgIf(sales, downtime = 0), 0) * 100, 2) AS diff_pct,
  round(avg(downtime), 3) AS avg_downtime,
  round((count() * sum(downtime * sales) - sum(downtime) * sum(sales))
        / nullIf(sqrt((count() * sum(downtime * downtime) - sum(downtime) * sum(downtime)) * (count() * sum(sales * sales) - sum(sales) * sum(sales))), 0), 4) AS pearson_r
FROM daily

turns.query:
WITH RECURSIVE anc AS (
    SELECT EntityKey AS leaf_key, EntityKey AS anc_key, toUInt8(0) AS lvl
    FROM retail.DimEntity
    WHERE EntityType = 'Store'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT a.leaf_key, parent.ParentEntityKey, a.lvl + 1
    FROM anc a
    JOIN retail.DimEntity child ON a.anc_key = child.EntityKey
    JOIN retail.DimEntity parent ON child.ParentEntityKey = parent.EntityKey
    WHERE parent.ParentEntityKey IS NOT NULL
      AND parent.ParentEntityKey != parent.EntityKey
      AND a.lvl < 5
)
SELECT
    d.EntityType                                   AS `组织层级`,
    count(DISTINCT d.EntityKey)                    AS `实体数`,
    count(DISTINCT anc.leaf_key)                   AS `覆盖门店数`,
    round(sum(p.Amount), 2)                        AS `销售收入`
FROM retail.FactStrategyPlan p
INNER JOIN retail.DimScenario s
        ON p.ScenarioKey = s.ScenarioKey AND s.ScenarioName = 'Budget'
INNER JOIN retail.DimAccount ac
        ON p.AccountKey = ac.AccountKey AND ac.AccountName = 'Sale Revenue'
INNER JOIN anc
        ON anc.leaf_key = p.EntityKey
INNER JOIN retail.DimEntity d
        ON d.EntityKey = anc.anc_key
GROUP BY d.EntityType
ORDER BY multiIf(d.EntityType = 'Group', 1,
                 d.EntityType = 'Country/Region', 2,
                 d.EntityType = 'State', 3, 4)
turns.assumption: 销售收入指战略计划表中预算（Budget）场景、科目 Sale Revenue 的金额合计，覆盖 2007-01 至 2009-12 全期；「组织层级」按 DimEntity 的门店 → 州 → 国家/地区 → 集团四级自下而上卷总，因此各级合计可跨层级比较但不加总；州（State）一层只覆盖挂在州下的 299 家门店，另有 7 家虚拟门店（线上/目录/经销）在组织树上直接挂在国家/地区下，故其收入不计入州一级。

) t
ORDER BY Rank

WITH base AS (

         if(c.ProductCategoryName IS NULL OR c.ProductCategoryName = '', '未知品类（产品维度缺失）', c.ProductCategoryName) AS cat,

FROM rates

  FROM retail.FactOnlineSales f

  LEFT JOIN retail.DimProductSubcategory s

  LEFT JOIN retail.DimProductCategory c
    ON s.ProductCategoryKey = c.ProductCategoryKey
  INNER JOIN retail.DimDate d

  GROUP BY category_name, year_label
)
SELECT

    gross_margin_pct - lagInFrame(gross_margin_pct) OVER (
      PARTITION BY category_name
      ORDER BY year_label
      ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING

  ) AS `毛利率变化(百分点)`
FROM yearly

         uniqExact(f.DateKey) AS days
  FROM retail.FactOnlineSales AS f
  INNER JOIN retail.DimPromotion AS p ON f.PromotionKey = p.PromotionKey
  INNER JOIN retail.DimStore AS s ON f.StoreKey = s.StoreKey
  WHERE f.SalesQuantity > 0
  GROUP BY sk, name, disc
),
calc AS (
  SELECT sk, name, disc, days,
         qty / days AS qpd,
         amt / nullIf(qty, 0) AS price
  FROM sales
),
base AS (
  SELECT sk, qpd AS q0, price AS p0
  FROM calc
  WHERE disc = 0
)
SELECT c.name AS `线上店`,
       c.disc AS `折扣率`,
       c.days AS `有销售天数`,
       round(c.qpd) AS `日均销量`,
       round(c.price, 2) AS `成交均价`,
       round(c.qpd - b.q0) AS `日均销量差`,
       round((c.qpd - b.q0) / b.q0, 4) AS `销量变化率`,
       round((c.price - b.p0) / b.p0, 4) AS `价格变化率`,
       if(c.disc = 0, CAST(NULL AS Nullable(Float64)),

FROM calc AS c
INNER JOIN base AS b ON c.sk = b.sk
ORDER BY c.name, c.disc

WITH base AS (
    SELECT ProductKey,
           sumIf(SalesQuantity, PromotionKey = 1) AS q_nd,
           uniqExactIf(DateKey, PromotionKey = 1) AS d_nd,
           sumIf(SalesAmount, PromotionKey = 1) AS a_nd
    FROM retail.FactOnlineSales
    GROUP BY ProductKey
), tier AS (
    SELECT f.ProductKey AS ProductKey,
           p.DiscountPercent AS dp,
           sum(f.SalesQuantity) AS q,
           uniqExact(f.DateKey) AS d,
           sum(f.SalesAmount) AS a
    FROM retail.FactOnlineSales f
    INNER JOIN retail.DimPromotion p ON f.PromotionKey = p.PromotionKey
    WHERE f.PromotionKey <> 1
    GROUP BY f.ProductKey, p.DiscountPercent
), j AS (
    SELECT t.dp,
           t.ProductKey,
           (t.q / t.d) / (b.q_nd / b.d_nd) AS q_ratio,
           (t.a / t.q) / (b.a_nd / b.q_nd) AS p_ratio
    FROM tier t
    INNER JOIN base b ON t.ProductKey = b.ProductKey
    WHERE t.q > 0 AND t.d > 0 AND b.q_nd > 0 AND b.d_nd > 0 AND b.a_nd > 0
)
SELECT round(dp * 100) AS `折扣档位_%`,
       count() AS `参与产品数`,
       round(avg(p_ratio), 4) AS `成交均价指数_相对无折扣`,
       round(avg(q_ratio), 3) AS `促销期日均销量指数_均值`,
       round(median(q_ratio), 3) AS `促销期日均销量指数_中位`,
       round(countIf(q_ratio > 1) / count() * 100, 1) AS `销量高于无折扣基准的产品占比_%`,
       round(avgIf(log(q_ratio) / log(p_ratio), abs(log(p_ratio)) > 0.001), 3) AS `价格弹性_均值`,
       round(medianIf(log(q_ratio) / log(p_ratio), abs(log(p_ratio)) > 0.001), 3) AS `价格弹性_中位`
FROM j
GROUP BY dp
ORDER BY dp

WITH q AS (
  SELECT c.ProductCategoryName AS category, toQuarter(f.DateKey) AS q, sum(f.SalesAmount) AS amt
  FROM retail.FactOnlineSales f
  INNER JOIN retail.DimProduct p ON f.ProductKey = p.ProductKey
  INNER JOIN retail.DimProductSubcategory s ON toInt32(p.ProductSubcategoryKey) = s.ProductSubcategoryKey
  INNER JOIN retail.DimProductCategory c ON s.ProductCategoryKey = c.ProductCategoryKey
  GROUP BY category, q
)
SELECT row_number() OVER (ORDER BY max(amt) / sum(amt) DESC) AS `名次`,
       category AS `产品品类`,
       concat('Q', toString(argMax(q, amt))) AS `最高销售季度`,
       max(amt) AS `最高季度销售额`,
       sum(amt) AS `全年销售额`,
       round(max(amt) / sum(amt) * 100, 2) AS `依赖度百分比`
FROM q GROUP BY category ORDER BY `依赖度百分比` DESC

WITH daily AS (
  SELECT
    ifNull(c.ProductCategoryName, '未知产品品类') AS `产品品类`,
    d.DateKey AS dt,
    d.IsHoliday AS hol,
    sum(s.SalesAmount) AS amt
  FROM retail.FactSales s
  INNER JOIN retail.DimDate d ON s.DateKey = d.DateKey
  LEFT JOIN retail.DimProduct p ON s.ProductKey = p.ProductKey
  LEFT JOIN retail.DimProductSubcategory sc ON p.ProductSubcategoryKey = sc.ProductSubcategoryKey
  LEFT JOIN retail.DimProductCategory c ON sc.ProductCategoryKey = c.ProductCategoryKey
  GROUP BY `产品品类`, dt, hol
)
SELECT
  row_number() OVER (ORDER BY weekend_avg - workday_avg DESC) AS `名次`,
  `产品品类`,
  round(weekend_avg, 2) AS `周末日均销售额`,
  round(workday_avg, 2) AS `工作日日均销售额`,
  round(weekend_avg - workday_avg, 2) AS `差额`,
  round((weekend_avg - workday_avg) / nullIf(workday_avg, 0) * 100, 2) AS `差额百分比`
FROM (
  SELECT
    `产品品类`,
    avgIf(amt, hol = 'Yes') AS weekend_avg,
    avgIf(amt, hol = 'No') AS workday_avg
  FROM daily
  GROUP BY `产品品类`
)
ORDER BY `差额` DESC

WITH base AS (
  SELECT
    ps.ProductSubcategoryName AS sub,
    f.ProductKey AS pk,
    toStartOfMonth(f.DateKey) AS m,
    sum(f.DiscountAmount) / nullIf(sum(f.SalesAmount + f.DiscountAmount), 0) AS disc_rate,
    sum(f.SalesQuantity) AS qty
  FROM retail.FactOnlineSales f
  INNER JOIN retail.DimProduct p ON f.ProductKey = p.ProductKey
  INNER JOIN retail.DimProductSubcategory ps ON p.ProductSubcategoryKey = ps.ProductSubcategoryKey
  WHERE f.DateKey >= toDate('2009-01-01')
    AND f.DateKey <= toDate('2009-12-31')
    AND f.PromotionKey != 1
    AND f.SalesQuantity > 0
  GROUP BY sub, pk, m
), agg AS (
  SELECT
    sub,
    count() AS n,
    corr(disc_rate, qty) AS c,
    sum(qty) AS total_qty,
    avg(disc_rate) AS avg_rate
  FROM base
  GROUP BY sub
)
SELECT
  row_number() OVER (ORDER BY c DESC) AS rnk,
  sub AS subcategory_name,
  round(c, 4) AS corr_disc_rate_qty,
  n AS sample_points,
  total_qty,
  round(avg_rate, 4) AS avg_disc_rate
FROM agg
ORDER BY c DESC

WITH product_half AS (
  SELECT
    f.ProductKey,
    sumIf(f.SalesAmount, toMonth(f.DateKey) <= 6) AS h1_sales,
    sumIf(f.SalesAmount, toMonth(f.DateKey) >= 7) AS h2_sales
  FROM retail.FactOnlineSales AS f
  WHERE toYear(f.DateKey) = 2009
  GROUP BY f.ProductKey
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT
    s.ProductKey,
    if(p.ProductKey = 0 OR p.ProductKey IS NULL,
       concat('未知产品 ', toString(s.ProductKey)),
       p.ProductName) AS product_name,
    s.h1_sales,
    s.h2_sales,
    s.h2_sales - s.h1_sales AS increase_amount,
    (s.h2_sales - s.h1_sales) / s.h1_sales * 100 AS increase_pct
  FROM product_half AS s
  LEFT JOIN retail.DimProduct AS p ON s.ProductKey = p.ProductKey
  WHERE s.h1_sales > 0 AND s.h2_sales > s.h1_sales
)
SELECT
  row_number() OVER (ORDER BY increase_amount DESC, ProductKey) AS rank_no,
  ProductKey,
  product_name,
  h1_sales,
  h2_sales,
  increase_amount,
  increase_pct
